def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """
    Multi-start greedy placement: try several model orderings (pressure desc,
    size desc, pressure/size ratio desc, original), each placing every model
    on the GPU minimizing the resulting KVPR; refine each feasible placement
    with a local search that moves or swaps models off the hottest GPU to
    lower the max KVPR; return the best placement found.
    """

    def greedy(sorted_models):
        placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
        free_mem = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
        pressure = [0.0] * gpu_num
        for model in sorted_models:
            best_idx, best_kvpr = None, float('inf')
            for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
                rem = free_mem[gpu_id] - model.model_size
                if rem > 0:
                    kvpr = (pressure[gpu_id] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / rem
                    if kvpr < best_kvpr:
                        best_kvpr, best_idx = kvpr, gpu_id
            if best_idx is None:
                return None
            placement[best_idx].append(model)
            pressure[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
            free_mem[best_idx] -= model.model_size
        return placement, free_mem, pressure

    orders = [
        sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True),
        sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.model_size, reverse=True),
        sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.req_rate / m.slo) / m.model_size, reverse=True),
        list(models),
    ]

    best_placement, best_score = None, float('inf')
    for sorted_models in orders:
        res = greedy(sorted_models)
        if res is None:
            continue
        placement, free_mem, pressure = res
        score = max(pressure[g] / free_mem[g] if free_mem[g] > 0 else float('inf')
                    for g in range(gpu_num))
        if score < best_score:
            best_placement, best_score = placement, score
            best_state = (free_mem, pressure)

    if best_placement is None:
        raise ValueError("Cannot fit all models into GPUs")

    placement = best_placement
    free_mem, pressure = best_state

    # Local search: move or swap models off the hottest GPU to reduce max KVPR
    def kvpr(gpu_id):
        return pressure[gpu_id] / free_mem[gpu_id] if free_mem[gpu_id] > 0 else float('inf')

    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        hot = max(range(gpu_num), key=kvpr)
        current_max = kvpr(hot)
        # try moving each model on the hot GPU to another GPU
        for model in list(placement[hot]):
            for dst in range(gpu_num):
                if dst == hot or model.model_size > free_mem[dst]:
                    continue
                rem_dst = free_mem[dst] - model.model_size
                new_dst = (pressure[dst] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / rem_dst
                new_hot = (pressure[hot] - model.req_rate / model.slo) / (free_mem[hot] + model.model_size)
                if max(new_dst, new_hot) < current_max:
                    placement[hot].remove(model)
                    placement[dst].append(model)
                    pressure[hot] -= model.req_rate / model.slo
                    free_mem[hot] += model.model_size
                    pressure[dst] += model.req_rate / model.slo
                    free_mem[dst] -= model.model_size
                    improved = True
                    break
            if improved:
                break
        if improved:
            continue
        # no move helped: try swapping a hot-GPU model with a cooler-GPU model
        for m_hot in list(placement[hot]):
            for dst in range(gpu_num):
                if dst == hot:
                    continue
                for m_dst in list(placement[dst]):
                    d = m_hot.model_size - m_dst.model_size
                    if m_hot.model_size > free_mem[dst] + m_dst.model_size or \
                       m_dst.model_size > free_mem[hot] + m_hot.model_size:
                        continue
                    p_hot = pressure[hot] - m_hot.req_rate / m_hot.slo + m_dst.req_rate / m_dst.slo
                    p_dst = pressure[dst] - m_dst.req_rate / m_dst.slo + m_hot.req_rate / m_hot.slo
                    new_hot = p_hot / (free_mem[hot] + d) if free_mem[hot] + d > 0 else float('inf')
                    new_dst = p_dst / (free_mem[dst] - d) if free_mem[dst] - d > 0 else float('inf')
                    if max(new_hot, new_dst) < current_max:
                        placement[hot].remove(m_hot)
                        placement[dst].remove(m_dst)
                        placement[hot].append(m_dst)
                        placement[dst].append(m_hot)
                        pressure[hot] = p_hot
                        pressure[dst] = p_dst
                        free_mem[hot] += d
                        free_mem[dst] -= d
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
            if improved:
                break

    return placement

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END


if __name__ == "__main__":
